products.name: T-Display
products.description: 1.14" IPS TFT LCD (135x240, ST7789V, SPI) development board. ESP32 dual-core 240MHz, 4MB/16MB Flash, WiFi 802.11 b/g/n, Bluetooth 4.2/BLE, USB-C (CH9102), battery charging via JST connector, 2 programmable buttons, ADC input, battery voltage detection. Compact form factor ideal for portable projects.

products.name: T-Display AMOLED Lite
products.description: 1.47" AMOLED display (194x368, SH8501B0, QSPI, 450 nits) development board. ESP32-S3R8 dual-core LX7, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, WiFi 2.4GHz, BLE 5.0, USB-C, battery charging/discharging support, 4 buttons (Boot/Power/Reset/IO21). First ESP32-S3 AMOLED board from LILYGO.

products.name: T-Display Bar
products.description: 2.25" bar-shaped IPS LCD (76x284, ST7789, capacitive touch) development board. ESP32-S3R8, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, WiFi/BLE 5.0, BHI260AP 6-axis IMU, buzzer, SD card slot, PCF8563 RTC, BQ25896 PMU + BQ27220 battery gauge, USB-C. Unique elongated form factor with rich sensor integration.

products.name: T-Display K230
products.description: 4.1" AMOLED touchscreen (568x1232, RM69A10) AI development board. Kendryte K230 dual RISC-V SoC (1.6GHz + 800MHz) with KPU AI accelerator + DPU + GPU + VPU, SX1262 LoRa (433/868/915/923MHz), camera input, HDMI output, H.264/H.265 codec, 2.5D GPU, 3D DPU, USB-C. Designed for AI edge computing, image recognition, and machine learning.

products.name: T-Display keyboard
products.description: 1.14" IPS LCD (135x240, ST7789V) with integrated mechanical keyboard. ESP32 dual-core, 4MB/16MB Flash, WiFi/Bluetooth 4.2, USB-C 5V/1A, JST 1.25mm battery connector (optional 2800mAh Type 805050), 500mA charging, multi-protocol interfaces (UART/SPI/I2C/I2S). BlackBerry-style portable terminal.

products.name: T-Display P4
products.description: 4.1" AMOLED (568x1232, RM69A10) or 4.05" TFT (540x1168, HI8561) with 10-point capacitive touch. ESP32-P4 dual-core RISC-V 360MHz + ESP32-C6 connectivity co-processor, 16MB+4MB Flash, 32MB PSRAM, WiFi 6 (802.11ax) via C6, BLE 5.0, SX1262 LoRa, L76K GPS, 2MP OV2710 MIPI camera (1080p@30fps), ICM20948 9-axis IMU, ES8311 DAC + speaker, microphone, motor, PCF8563 RTC, BQ27220 battery gauge, Ethernet support. The most feature-rich T-Display ever.

products.name: T-Display S3
products.description: 1.9" IPS TFT LCD (170x320, ST7789, SPI) development board. ESP32-S3R8 dual-core LX7 240MHz, 16MB Flash, 8MB OPI PSRAM, WiFi 802.11 b/g/n, BLE 5.0, USB-C (CDC + JTAG), touch and non-touch variants, battery voltage detection, 2 programmable buttons, backlight control (GPIO15). Popular for custom watch faces and portable UI projects.

products.name: T-Display S3 AMOLED
products.description: 1.91" AMOLED display (240x536, RM67162, QSPI, 350 nits) development board. ESP32-S3R8, 16MB Flash, 8MB OPI PSRAM, WiFi/BLE 5.0, USB-C (JTAG), touch and non-touch variants, QSPI display interface (4x faster than SPI), battery voltage detection. Vibrant AMOLED with deep blacks.

products.name: T-Display S3 AMOLED (DS)
products.description: Compact AMOLED display board series (DS) with multiple display variants: 1.64" (280x456, ICNA3311 QSPI), 1.75" round (466x466, SH8601 QSPI), or 1.43" round (466x466, SH8601 QSPI). ESP32-S3R8, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, WiFi/BLE 5.0, USB-C, battery voltage detection (IO04). Multiple form factors including round displays.

products.name: T-Display S3 AMOLED Plus
products.description: 1.91" AMOLED display (240x536, RM67162, SPI, capacitive touch, 350 nits) Plus version. ESP32-S3R8, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, WiFi/BLE 5.0, USB-C, RTC, PMU, SD card slot, metal shielding cover, external FPC antenna, battery holder included. Enhanced version with RTC, PMU and SD card.

products.name: T-Display S3 Long
products.description: 3.4" ultra-wide capacitive touch TFT LCD (180x640, QSPI, 16/18-bit color) development board. ESP32-S3R8, 16MB Flash, 8MB OPI PSRAM, WiFi 802.11, BLE 5.0 + BT Mesh, USB-C (JTAG), battery voltage detection (IO02), onboard battery switch. Elongated display perfect for scrolling text, progress bars, and music visualization.

products.name: T-Display S3 Pro
products.description: 2.33" IPS TFT LCD (222x480, ST7796, SPI, capacitive touch) professional board. ESP32-S3R8, 16MB Flash, 8MB OPI PSRAM, WiFi/BLE 5.0, USB-C (JTAG + USB Host/OTG), SY6970 power path management, LTR553ALS light & proximity sensor, camera shield support, physical ON/OFF switch, backlight PWM control. Pro version with USB OTG and sensor.

products.name: T-Display S3 Pro External
products.description: T-Display S3 Pro variant with external display connector. ESP32-S3 dual-core LX7, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, WiFi/BLE 5.0, USB-C, external display interface for custom screen modules.

products.name: T-Display S3 Pro LR1121
products.description: 2.33" IPS TFT LCD (222x480, ST7796, capacitive touch) with dual-band LoRa. ESP32-S3R8, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, WiFi/BLE 5.0 Mesh, LR1121 LoRa dual-band (Sub-GHz 830-940MHz + 2.4GHz), integrated 2000mAh Li-ion battery, motor vibration, PCF8563 RTC, speaker, microphone, dual external LoRa antenna ports, 1/4" screw mount, USB-C.

products.name: T-Deck
products.description: Handheld computer with 2.8" IPS TFT LCD (320x240, ST7789), mini QWERTY keyboard, trackball navigation. ESP32-S3FN16R8, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, WiFi/BLE 5.0, optional SX1262 LoRa (433/868/915MHz, +22dBm), microphone, speaker, no GPS (standard version), USB-C. Ideal for Meshtastic, messaging, and portable terminal.

products.name: T-Deck Meshtastic
products.description: T-Deck pre-loaded with Meshtastic firmware. ESP32-S3FN16R8, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, 2.8" ST7789 IPS LCD (320x240), SX1262 LoRa (433/868/915MHz, +22dBm), mini keyboard, trackball, microphone, speaker, WiFi/BLE 5.0. Ready-to-use off-grid mesh messenger.

products.name: T-Deck Plus
products.description: Enhanced T-Deck with GPS and backlit keyboard. ESP32-S3FN16R8 + ESP32-C3 (keyboard controller), 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, 2.8" ST7789 IPS LCD (320x240), SX1262 LoRa (433/868/915MHz), integrated GPS module, backlit T-Keyboard, trackball, microphone, speaker, WiFi/BLE 5.0, 2000mAh battery, USB-C.

products.name: T-Deck Plus Meshtastic
products.description: T-Deck Plus pre-loaded with Meshtastic firmware. ESP32-S3FN16R8 + ESP32-C3 keyboard controller, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, 2.8" IPS LCD, SX1262 LoRa, GPS, backlit keyboard, trackball, mic, speaker, 2000mAh battery. GPS-enabled mesh communicator.

products.name: T-Deck Pro
products.description: Professional T-Deck with 3.2" GDEQ031T10 E-Paper display (320x240) with CST328 touch. ESP32-S3, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, SX1262 LoRa, MIA-M10Q GPS, BHI260AP 6-axis IMU, LTR-553ALS light sensor, optional A7682E 4G LTE Cat-1 module, optional PCM5102A audio codec, BQ25896+BQ27220 battery management, 1400mAh battery, TCA8418 keyboard controller, microphone, SD card, WiFi/BLE 5.0. E-Paper display for sunlight readability.

products.name: T-Deck Pro Meshtastic
products.description: T-Deck Pro pre-loaded with Meshtastic firmware. 3.2" E-Paper touch display, ESP32-S3, SX1262 LoRa, MIA-M10Q GPS, BHI260AP IMU, LTR-553ALS sensor, optional 4G LTE, BQ25896+BQ27220 PMU, 1400mAh battery, keyboard, mic, SD card. Professional mesh communicator with E-Paper.

products.name: T-Beam
products.description: LoRa + GPS development board. ESP32-D0WDQ6-V3 dual-core 240MHz, 4MB Flash (QSPI), 8MB PSRAM (QSPI), SX1276/SX1278 LoRa (868/915MHz), Ublox NEO-6M or NEO-M8N GPS, AXP2101 PMU, 0.96" SSD1306 OLED (128x64, I2C), WiFi/Bluetooth 4.2, 18650 battery holder, USB-C charging up to 1024mA. Classic LoRa tracker board.

products.name: T-Beam 1W
products.description: High-power 1 Watt LoRa board. ESP32-S3, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM (QSPI), SX1262 TCXO LoRa (433/868/915MHz) with 1W PA (+32dBm max output), L76K GPS, SH1106 OLED, WiFi/BLE 5.0, requires external 7.4V battery (2A+ discharge), no built-in USB charging, PMU with 6s shutdown. Up to 10km+ line-of-sight range.

products.name: T-Beam BPF
products.description: T-Beam with VHF Band Pass Filter. ESP32-S3, 16MB Flash, 8MB OPI PSRAM, SX1278 TCXO LoRa with BPF (144-148MHz VHF band), L76K GPS, AXP2101 PMU, 0.96" SH1106 OLED (128x64), WiFi/BLE 5.0, 3.7V Li-ion with BMS, USB-C 1024mA charging. Optimized for VHF amateur radio LoRa.

products.name: T-Beam Helium
products.description: T-Beam for Helium IoT network. ESP32, 4MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, SX1276 LoRa (868/915MHz, -148dBm sensitivity, 300kbps), NEO-6M GPS, AXP2101 PMU, WiFi/Bluetooth 4.2, onboard RTC crystal with interrupt/wakeup, CH9102 USB, 18650 battery holder, 3 buttons (Power+IO38+Reset).

products.name: T-Beam Meshtastic
products.description: T-Beam pre-loaded with Meshtastic firmware. ESP32, SX1262 LoRa, GPS, 18650 battery holder, WiFi/Bluetooth 4.2. Ready-to-use long-range mesh communicator with GPS positioning.

products.name: T-Beam SoftRF
products.description: T-Beam pre-loaded with SoftRF firmware for aviation. ESP32, SX1262 LoRa, GPS, 18650 battery holder, WiFi/Bluetooth 4.2. Aircraft/glider traffic awareness and tracking system.

products.name: T-Beam-Shiled-V1.0
products.description: Expansion shield for T-Beam providing additional I/O, sensor connectors, and prototyping area. Compatible with T-Beam V1.0 series. Not a standalone MCU board.

products.name: T-Beam SUPREME
products.description: Premium T-Beam with rich sensor suite. ESP32-S3FN8, 8MB Flash (QSPI), 8MB PSRAM (QSPI), SX1262 LoRa (868/915MHz) or LR1121 dual-band (830-945MHz + 2.4GHz), L76K or Ublox M10 GPS, AXP2101 PMU, 1.3" SH1106 OLED, QMI8658 6-axis IMU, QMC6310 magnetometer, BME280 environmental sensor (temp/humidity/pressure), PCF8563 RTC, SD card slot, WiFi/BLE 5.0, 18650 battery holder, USB-C. The most sensor-rich T-Beam.

products.name: T-Beam SUPREME Meshtastic
products.description: T-Beam SUPREME pre-loaded with Meshtastic firmware. ESP32-S3FN8, 8MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, SX1262 LoRa (433/868/915/920MHz), GPS, AXP2101 PMU, 1.3" OLED, QMI8658 IMU, QMC6310 magnetometer, BME280 sensor, PCF8563 RTC, SD card, WiFi/BLE 5.0, 18650 battery.

products.name: T3 LoRa32 V1.6.1
products.description: Compact LoRa32 V1.6.1. ESP32-PICO-D4, 4MB Flash (QSPI), no PSRAM, SX1276 LoRa (840-945MHz, FSK/GFSK/MSK/GMSK/LoRa/OOK), 0.96" SSD1306 OLED (128x64, I2C), WiFi/Bluetooth 4.2, 3.7V Li-ion (no BMS, requires protected battery), SD card slot, USB-C 500mA charging.

products.name: T3 S3
products.description: Compact LoRa board with ESP32-S3. 0.96" OLED display, LoRa options: SX1262/SX1276 (868/915MHz) or SX1280 (2.4GHz), WiFi/BLE 5.0, 3.7V LiPo battery support, SD card slot, USB-C, Reset + Boot buttons.

products.name: T3 S3 E-paper
products.description: LoRa board with 2.13" DEPG0213BN E-Paper display (250x122). ESP32-S3FH4R2, 4MB Flash, 2MB PSRAM, SX1262 LoRa (868/915MHz) or SX1280 (2.4GHz without PA), WiFi/BLE 5.0, 3.7V LiPo battery with switch, SD card slot, USB-C. Ultra-low-power LoRa sensor node with persistent display.

products.name: T3 S3 LR1121
products.description: Compact LoRa board with LR1121 dual-band radio. ESP32-S3FH4R2, 4MB Flash, 2MB PSRAM, 0.96" SSD1306 OLED (128x64), LR1121 LoRa dual-band (830-940MHz + 2.4GHz), WiFi/BLE 5.0, 3.7V LiPo, USB 500mA charging, SD card, 66x36mm. Optional MVSRE variant with speaker + microphone.

products.name: T3 S3 Meshtastic
products.description: T3 S3 pre-loaded with Meshtastic firmware. ESP32-S3, SX1262 LoRa, 0.96" OLED, WiFi/BLE 5.0. Compact ready-to-use Meshtastic node.

products.name: T3 S3 V1.3
products.description: Updated T3 S3 V1.3 LoRa board. ESP32-S3FH4R2, 4MB Flash, 2MB PSRAM, 0.96" SSD1306 OLED (128x64, I2C, SDA=IO18/SCL=IO17), LoRa options: SX1262/SX1276/SX1280/LR1121 (433/868/915MHz/2.4GHz), WiFi/BLE 5.0, 3.7V LiPo, SD card, USB-C.

products.name: T3-S3 MVSR
products.description: T3 S3 MVSR (voice communication kit). ESP32-S3FH4R2, 4MB Flash, 2MB PSRAM, 0.96" OLED, LoRa (SX1262/SX1276/SX1280), MAX98357A speaker amplifier, MSM261S4030HOR microphone, vibration motor, WiFi/BLE 5.0, 3.7V LiPo, SD card, 66x15x27mm. LoRa voice messaging.

products.name: T3 STM32
products.description: LoRa board with STM32WL55CCU6 dual-core (ARM Cortex-M4 + Cortex-M0+). 256KB Flash, 64KB SRAM, integrated SX1262 LoRa transceiver on-chip (433/868/915MHz, LoRa/FSK/GFSK/MSK/GMSK/BPSK), 0.96" SSD1315 OLED (128x64), no WiFi, no Bluetooth, no GPS, no PSRAM. Ultra-compact STM32-based LoRa node.

products.name: T3 TCXO
products.description: T3 LoRa board with TCXO (Temperature Compensated Crystal Oscillator) for improved frequency stability. ESP32-S3, SX1262 LoRa with TCXO, 0.96" OLED, WiFi/BLE 5.0. Better frequency accuracy across temperature ranges.

products.name: T-Lora C6
products.description: ESP32-C6 compact LoRa board. 4MB Flash, no PSRAM, no display. WiFi 6 (2.4GHz 802.11ax), BLE 5.0, 802.15.4 (Thread/Zigbee/Matter capable). SX1262 LoRa (433/868/915MHz). BOOT + Reset buttons, custom LED, FPC antenna with 3D-printed holder. Supports C/C++, MicroPython, Lua. Ultra-compact. The only LILYGO LoRa board with WiFi 6 and Thread/Zigbee/Matter.

products.name: T-Lora Dual
products.description: ESP32 dual-band LoRa board. ESP32-PICO-D4, 4MB Flash, no PSRAM, no display. WiFi/Bluetooth 4.2. Dual LR1121 LoRa transceivers (Sub-GHz + 1.9GHz/2.4GHz, LoRa/FSK modulation). Shared SPI bus with independent CS/RST/BUSY/IRQ per module. Concurrent multi-band communication. ExpressLRS flight control compatible. No battery, no sensors, no display.

products.name: T-Lora Pager
products.description: ESP32-S3 handheld LoRa communicator. 16MB Flash (QSPI), 8MB PSRAM (QSPI), 2.33" IPS LCD (ST7796U SPI, 480x222, 262K colors, 450 cd/m², AW9364 16-level backlight). WiFi/BLE 5.0. LoRa SX1262 (433/868/915/920MHz) or SX1280 2.4GHz. Optional CC1101/LR1121/SI4432 radio modules. GNSS UBlox MIA-M10Q GPS. NFC ST25R3916. BHI260AP smart sensor (accel/gyro). TCA8418 I2C keyboard with backlight. Rotary encoder. ES8311 audio codec + NS4150B 3W speaker. DRV2605 haptic. PCF85063A RTC. BQ25896+BQ27220 PMU. XL9555 GPIO expander. SD card (32GB max). USB-C (can output 5V). 1500mAh battery (5.55Wh). 12-pin expansion header. nRF24L01 PA shield compatible. The most feature-rich LILYGO handheld.

products.name: T-Lora Pager Meshtastic
products.description: T-Lora Pager pre-loaded with Meshtastic/MeshCore firmware. Identical hardware: 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, 2.33" IPS LCD (ST7796U, 480x222), SX1262 LoRa, MIA-M10Q GPS, NFC ST25R3916, BHI260AP sensor, TCA8418 keyboard, rotary encoder, ES8311 audio + NS4150B speaker, DRV2605 haptic, PCF85063A RTC, BQ25896+BQ27220 PMU, SD card, 1500mAh battery. Same expansion options (nRF24L01/LR1121 shields).

products.name: T-Watch 2021
products.description: ESP32 smartwatch (2021 edition). 8MB Flash, 2MB PSRAM, 1.3" round IPS LCD (GC9A01, 240x240, capacitive touch), WiFi 802.11 b/g/n, BLE 4.2, BMA423 accelerometer with pedometer, RTC with alarm interrupt, vibration motor, Micro-USB. No LoRa, no GPS. Compact watch form factor for custom watch faces and wearable projects.

products.name: T-Watch S3
products.description: ESP32-S3 smartwatch. 16MB Flash (QSPI), 8MB PSRAM (QSPI), 1.3" IPS LCD (ST7789V3 SPI, 240x240, 262K colors, 450 cd/m², capacitive touch FT6336U). WiFi/BLE 5.0. LoRa SX1262 (433/868/915/920MHz or SX1280 2.4GHz variants). BMA423 accelerometer. AXP2101 PMU. DRV2605 haptic driver. PDM microphone (SPM1423HM4H-B). MAX98357A 3.2W Class D speaker. PCF8563 RTC. IR transmitter (IR12-21C). 1500mAh battery (5.55Wh). Micro-USB. No GPS. Supports Meshtastic, MeshCore, and custom firmware.

products.name: T-Watch S3 Plus
products.description: ESP32-S3 smartwatch with GPS. 16MB Flash (QSPI), 8MB PSRAM (QSPI), 1.3" IPS LCD (ST7789V3 SPI, 240x240, 262K colors, capacitive touch FT6336U). WiFi/BLE 5.0. LoRa SX1262 (433/868/915/920MHz or SX1280 2.4GHz). GNSS UBlox MIA-M10Q GPS. BMA423 accelerometer. AXP2101 PMU. DRV2605 haptic driver. PDM microphone (SPM1423HM4H-B). MAX98357A speaker. PCF8563 RTC. IR transmitter. 1500mAh battery (5.55Wh). Same as T-Watch S3 plus GPS module. Supports MeshCore, Meshtastic.

products.name: T-Watch Ultra
products.description: ESP32-S3 premium smartwatch. 16MB Flash (QSPI), 8MB PSRAM (QSPI), 2.06" AMOLED (CO5300 QSPI, 410x502, 16.7M colors, 600 nit, 60000:1 contrast, capacitive touch CST9217). WiFi/BLE 5.0. SX1262 LoRa. NFC ST25R3916. GNSS UBlox MIA-M10Q GPS. BHI260AP smart sensor (accelerometer/gyroscope). AXP2101 PMU. DRV2605 haptic. PDM microphone (TDK T3902). MAX98357A 3.2W speaker. PCF85063A RTC. XL9555 GPIO expander. SD card (max 32GB). 1100mAh battery (4.07Wh). USB-C. 49x63.5x22mm. The most feature-rich LILYGO watch.

products.name: T-Embed
products.description: ESP32-S3 handheld dev board base platform. 16MB Flash, 8MB OPI PSRAM, 1.9" IPS TFT LCD (ST7789, 320x170), WiFi/BLE 5.0, rotary encoder (doubles as BOOT button), built-in speaker, PDM microphone (disabled when CC1101 shield attached), WS2812 addressable LEDs, MicroSD card slot, USB-C with JTAG. No battery included, no LoRa, no GPS. Designed as base platform for CC1101/SI4732 expansion shields.

products.name: T-Embed CC1101
products.description: ESP32-S3 sub-GHz multi-tool. 16MB Flash, 8MB OPI PSRAM, 1.9" IPS TFT LCD (ST7789V, 320x170, SPI). WiFi/BLE 5.0. CC1101 sub-GHz transceiver (300-348/387-464/779-928 MHz, ~50m range). PN532 NFC (13.56MHz HF, MIFARE Classic + NTAG). IR transmit and receive. WS2812 LEDs (8 LEDs). Rotary encoder. I2S speaker. BQ25896 charger + BQ27220 fuel gauge, 1300mAh battery. MicroSD card. USB-C. Optional nRF24L01 expansion. Compatible with Bruce firmware (Flipper Zero alternative).

products.name: T-Embed CC1101 Plus
products.description: T-Embed CC1101 with built-in nRF24L01 2.4GHz radio module. 16MB Flash, 8MB OPI PSRAM, 1.9" IPS TFT LCD (ST7789V, 320x170). WiFi/BLE 5.0. CC1101 sub-GHz (300-348/387-464/779-928 MHz). nRF24L01 2.4GHz wireless (soldered on PCB, GPIO44 CS/GPIO43 CE). PN532 NFC (13.56MHz). IR TX/RX. WS2812 LEDs. Rotary encoder. Speaker. BQ25896+BQ27220 PMU, 1300mAh battery. MicroSD. USB-C. All CC1101 features plus 2.4GHz wireless.

products.name: T-Embed SI4732
products.description: ESP32-S3 AM/FM/SW radio receiver. 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, 1.9" IPS TFT LCD (ST7789V, 320x170, SPI). WiFi/BLE 5.0. SI4732-A10 CMOS AM/FM/SW/LW/RDS radio receiver IC. Rotary encoder. 900mAh battery (702550 cell). Battery voltage detection on IO04. USB-C. No LoRa, no NFC, no GPS. Software-defined radio receiver with touchscreen UI.

products.name: T-Camera Plus S3
products.description: Camera development board. ESP32-S3R8, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, OV2640/OV5640 camera, WiFi 802.11 b/g/n, BLE 5.0, microphone + MAX98357A speaker, no built-in display. Ideal for smart doorbell, security camera, video streaming, and voice interaction projects.

products.name: T-Camera S3
products.description: Compact camera board with display. ESP32-S3, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, OV2640 2MP camera, 0.96" SSD1306 OLED (128x64), WiFi 802.11 b/g/n, BLE 5.0. Compact IP camera and vision AI platform.

products.name: T-Connect
products.description: Industrial connectivity hub. ESP32-S3, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, WiFi 2.4GHz, BLE 5.0, RS485 + CAN bus interfaces, APA102 LED. No display. Industrial IoT gateway for sensor and automation networks.

products.name: T-Connect Pro
products.description: Professional IoT connectivity module. ESP32-S3R8, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, optional 1.9" display, WiFi/BLE 5.0, LoRa (433/868/915/920MHz), onboard relay, capacitive touch, DC input. Multi-protocol industrial IoT platform.

products.name: T-Echo LILYGO
products.description: E-Paper LoRa board with Nordic nRF52840. ARM Cortex-M4F 64MHz, 1MB Flash, 256KB RAM, 1.54" E-Paper display, SX1262 LoRa, L76K GPS, BME280 sensor (temp/humidity/pressure), BLE 5.0, USB-C, 850mAh battery. Ultra-low power LoRa node with persistent display.

products.name: T-Echo Lite
products.description: Simplified T-Echo variant. nRF52840, 1.54" E-Paper display, SX1262 LoRa, BLE 5.0, USB-C, battery support. Streamlined version without GPS for cost-effective mesh nodes.

products.name: T-Echo Meshtastic
products.description: T-Echo pre-loaded with Meshtastic firmware. nRF52840, 1.54" E-Paper, SX1262 LoRa, GPS, BME280 sensor, BLE 5.0, 850mAh battery. Ready-to-use ultra-low-power Meshtastic node.

products.name: T-Echo Plus
products.description: Enhanced T-Echo with additional features. nRF52840, 1.54" E-Paper display, SX1262 LoRa, GPS, BME280 sensor, BLE 5.0, USB-C, enhanced battery life. Upgraded E-Paper LoRa device.

products.name: T-Echo SoftRF
products.description: T-Echo pre-loaded with SoftRF aviation firmware. nRF52840, 1.54" E-Paper, SX1262 LoRa, GPS, BLE 5.0. Aircraft traffic awareness for gliders and ultralight aviation.

products.name: T-TWR/ SOLD OUT
products.description: Two-Way Radio (walkie-talkie). ESP32-S3, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, 0.96" SSD1306 OLED (128x64), SA868 UHF/VHF/350MHz radio transceiver, WiFi/BLE 5.0, 18650 battery holder, rotary encoder switch, USB-C. Digital and analog two-way radio.

products.name: T-TWR Plus
products.description: Enhanced Two-Way Radio with GPS. ESP32-S3, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, 1.3" SH1106 OLED (128x64), SA868 radio transceiver, L76K GNSS (GPS/BDS/GLONASS), AXP2102 PMU, WiFi/BLE 5.0, 21700/18650 battery, WS2812 LED, USB-C. Walkie-talkie with GPS positioning.

products.name: T-TWR REV2.1
products.description: T-TWR Revision 2.1 with refined design. ESP32-S3, 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, 1.3" SH1106 OLED (128x64), UHF 400-480MHz or VHF 134-174MHz radio, L76K GNSS, AXP2102 PMU, WiFi/BLE 5.0, 21700/18650 battery. Meshtastic and APRS compatible.

products.name: T-PCIE
products.description: Mini PCIe form factor IoT gateway. ESP32, mini PCIe slot for 4G/LTE modules, SIM card slot, WiFi/Bluetooth, USB, Ethernet (optional). Versatile cellular IoT gateway supporting various cellular modules.

products.name: T-A7670E/G/SA R2
products.description: 4G LTE cellular IoT board. ESP32, A7670E/G/SA LTE Cat-1 module (R2 version), SIM card slot, GPS (optional), WiFi/Bluetooth 4.2, USB-C. Global 4G LTE connectivity for IoT applications.

products.name: T-SIM7000E
products.description: 4G LTE cellular development board. ESP32, SIM7600E/SIM7000E module, SIM card slot, GPS/GNSS, WiFi/Bluetooth 4.2, USB-C, antenna connectors. High-speed 4G LTE data with GPS tracking.

products.name: T-SIM7000G

products.name: T-SIM7070G
